services.name: Dazzle Dry manicure and Dazzle Dry pedicure

reviews.author: Gabby C…
reviews.body:
I absolutely loved my experience!! 

I’m so happy with my nails: they turned out beautiful! The work was flawless, with incredible attention to detail and a perfect finish. She was also kind, professional, and made the entire appointment enjoyable.

The space itself was just as amazing. It’s private, spacious, spotless, and incredibly welcoming. I was able to truly relax, clear my mind, and enjoy some much-needed time for myself. The atmosphere is peaceful and makes you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for exceptional nail services and a relaxing, high-quality experience. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.body: Loved my experience with Arleen! She was incredibly detail oriented and efficient. My nails came out perfect! 💯
